title: finance-legal personal todo
content:
Quick personal TODO (scratchpad) - finance/legal

1) Invoices to reconcile (high priority)
- INV-2024-087 (Vendor: CloudFleet) — $24,780 — due 2024-11-10 — marked PENDING (need PO match). Check PO #PO-8892, ask procurement if partial shipment OK.
- INV-2024-092 (Contractor: BrightOps) — $3,120 — due 2024-11-16 — submitted but missing W9 from BrightOps. Email pm + vendor for W9.
- INV-2024-101 (SaaS: Datadash) — $1,250 — dispute: overcharged for extra seats. Open ticket with vendor (support ref 4521).

Notes: scan and attach receipts to Expensify before sending to accounting. Reconcile credit memos (CM-11) with INV-2024-087.

2) Contracts / redlines (in progress)
- CloudFleet MSA (vendor A) — Received doc 2024-11-01. Key asks: SLAs for Dedicated (latency SLA), data residency clause (add EU data processing), indemnity cap. Draft redline (first pass) — TODO: add alternative language for IP carveouts. Target: send to vendor by 2024-11-18.
- Contractor SOW (BrightOps) — Need to clarify deliverable acceptance criteria and payment milestones. Remove open-ended reimbursement clause.
- Office Lease amendment (workspace) — legal flagged insurance limits; confirm with real estate team.

3) Renewals / Alerts
- Okta enterprise subscription — renewal 2025-01-03 — need procurement estimate for Dedicated team.
- Zendesk (Support plan) — auto-renew 2024-12-01 — check usage and downgrade possibility for non-prod.
- Domain renewals (redwood.ai) — 2024-11-30 — ensure auto-renew enabled and billing card updated.

4) Action items (short)
- [ ] Email Tara: confirm whether PO-8892 covers partial shipments (INV-2024-087).
- [ ] Chase BrightOps for W9 + updated invoice.
- [ ] Draft redline bullets for CloudFleet MSA (share with Leo for legal review).
- [ ] Add invoice disputes to FIN-342 and note expected resolution date.
- [ ] Update payment method for domains in lastpass/billing account.

5) Meeting prep — 2024-11-15 Legal <-> Finance sync
- Agenda: MSA redlines prioritization, large vendor invoices backlog, renewal calendar (Q1).
- Questions for Leo: acceptable indemnity cap ranges for vendor MSAs; standard EU DPA language we should request; recommended clause for quantization/IP attributions for model weights.
- Attachments to prepare: current MSA draft, invoice spreadsheet (INV-2024-080..INV-2024-105), renewal tracker.

6) Draft emails / snippets
- To vendor (CloudFleet): "Thanks for the MSA. We're generally aligned but have a couple of redlines around data residency and liability cap — attaching our proposed markups and a short rationale. Happy to hop on a call next week to accelerate."
- To accounting: "Hi team — forwarding INV-2024-087; PO-8892 may need amendment due to partial deliverables. Please hold payment until PO verification?"

7) Misc notes / reminders
- Confirm expense policy for external training reimbursements (Tara to confirm limits).
- Keep a folder: /finance/invoices/2024/nov for scanned docs (ask admin to upload).
- Follow up on refund status for overcharge from Datadash (support ref 4521) — escalate if no reply in 5 business days.

Last quick log: 2024-11-14 09:20 — added CloudFleet MSA notes; flagged INV-2024-087 as PENDING.
